plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Self-serve pay-as-you-go account, no platform fee; GPU quota may need a request.

caveats: Embedded official catalog provides per-minute EUR ex-VAT rates and regional shapes. USD equivalents use ECB September 28, 2026 reference 1 EUR = 1.1378 USD; invoice is still EUR and bank FX/spreads may differ. native_node_hour=exact perMinute×60. Approximate monthly display is not a contractual cap.
Any null count, CPU/RAM, billing increment or minimum is unverified, not unlimited/free.
This is GPU-product research, not a claim that every feature of the entire vendor documentation was audited. Unverified features are null.
Unknown fee, storage or bandwidth means full monthly total may be unavailable. Rates exclude taxes.

Multi-GPU SKUs (2/4/8 GPUs) priced per GPU with gpu_min_count = N (sold only as N-GPU instances); the 'alt' flag was removed (ordinary GPU VMs, not an adjacent product). Per-GPU rates from the page __NEXT_DATA__ per-minute catalog (research/providers/scaleway-gpu.json, 2026-09-28); live page check: L4-2/4/8 EUR 1.58/3.15/6.30 per hour = 2/4/8 x L4-1 EUR 0.79.

Block storage: Block Storage 5K EUR 0.000130/GB-h (~EUR 0.0949/GB-month, disk_gib_month converted at 1.1378) billed while the volume exists; 15K tier EUR 0.000177/GB-h; Block/Unified Snapshot EUR 0.000049/GB-h (scaleway.com/en/pricing/storage, 2026-09-28). GPU instances list "Block storage" (+ free scratch NVMe on L40S/H100/B300) with no included boot volume, so included_disk_gib 0.

Egress: the GPU pricing page publishes no egress charge; Scaleway Virtual Instances say "List prices include egress and IPv6" but the GPU page does not repeat it, so egress_gib stays null (unverified, not free). Flexible IPv4 EUR 0.005/h (scaleway.com/en/pricing/network).

Structure 2026-09-28: the catalog listed each SKU once per availability zone (fr-par-1/fr-par-2/pl-waw-2) at the same price; duplicates merged into one regime per SKU, label names the zones. Removed keys: on-demand-h100-2-80g-h100-pcie-5, on-demand-h100-1-80g-h100-pcie-7, on-demand-l40s-8-48g-l40s-9, on-demand-l40s-4-48g-l40s-11, on-demand-l40s-2-48g-l40s-13, on-demand-l40s-1-48g-l40s-15, on-demand-l4-8-24g-l4-17, on-demand-l4-8-24g-l4-18, on-demand-l4-4-24g-l4-20, on-demand-l4-4-24g-l4-21, on-demand-l4-2-24g-l4-23, on-demand-l4-2-24g-l4-24, on-demand-l4-1-24g-l4-26, on-demand-l4-1-24g-l4-27.

Every GPU Instance needs a block boot volume (min 10 GB, 125 GB recommended for GPU OS): 125 GB x EUR 0.000130/GB-h = ~EUR 11.9 (~$13.5)/month while the volume exists, billed even when powered off. A flexible IPv4 (EUR 0.005/h) is created by default unless unticked.
No commitment discount exists for GPU Instances: Compute Savings Plans (up to 25%) exclude B300, H100, RENDER, L4, L40S. Only on-demand pricing (or Elastic Metal monthly / sales contracts).
Standby (stop-in-place) bills full compute; only 'power off' (archive) stops GPU billing. Kapsule GPU node pools are billed from creation, including GPU-operator setup time.

fleet.verification: Validated payment method plus identity verification; higher-end/multi-GPU shapes require support.
fleet.tiers: Payment-only accounts cannot use GPU Instances. Identity unlocks 1 RENDER-S, L4-1 or L40S-1 per listed shape; H100/multi-GPU shapes need support.
fleet.notes: Zero describes before identity verification; not a claim of zero after verified onboarding. Higher limits require human review.
